title: lyn's vanilla+
description: vanilla+ modpack for performance and visual aesthetics
body:
# lyn's vanilla+

compatible with all vanilla servers, built for aesthetics and beauty. designed for both survival and creative builders, explorers and adventures
## primary features

as minecraft develops year by year, players have outpaced mojang's ability to provide them the tools, aesthetics and convenience required of the modern experience. this modpack, while being compatible with all vanilla servers, makes changes to the games visuals, gameplay and function, bringing them in line with players' expectations
### masa's collection
[masa](https://github.com/maruohon) is one of the most important modders in the history of the scene and their advanced tools have become something i can no longer live without.
- [litematica](https://modrinth.com/mod/litematica) for transfering my creative builds into survival via schematics and easy place mode
- [tweakeroo](https://modrinth.com/mod/tweakeroo) for convenient tweaks like flexible placement, item restocking, fullbright gamma and plenty more
- [minihud](https://modrinth.com/mod/minihud) for world and gamestate info, the light level overlay, shape renderers, structure bounding boxes and a slime chunk overlay
- [itemscroller](https://modrinth.com/mod/item-scroller) as a more functional and compatible replacement for YaLTeR's mouse tweaks
### audiovisual changes
a small group of mods that massively change how we see and hear the world, all using custom configs for unobtrusiveness
- [simple fog control](https://modrinth.com/mod/simplefog) for custom fog distancing that reacts to weather and location
- [better clouds](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-clouds) spices up the skies with a style aligning with classic vanilla
- [sound physics remastered](https://modrinth.com/mod/sound-physics-remastered) adds realistic sound attenuation, reverberation, and absorption through blocks
- [ambientsounds](https://modrinth.com/mod/ambientsounds) for a rich atmosphere. if you're worried about this mod, know that its been toned down massively via the config
### gameplay conveniences
- [itemswapper](https://modrinth.com/plugin/itemswapper) adds a powerful inventory sorting and swapping tool that reduces confusion from inventory clutter
- [axiom](https://modrinth.com/mod/axiom) is the revolutionary creative only building tool designed as an all-in-one comprehensive solution for real-time and detailed minecraft world adjustments
- [clientsort](https://modrinth.com/mod/clientsort) is a one button inventory and storage sorter that works on all servers
- [sound controller](https://modrinth.com/mod/sound-controller) for muting the pesky audio queues that annoy us all
